perspective:
Keith’s available information:

- Keith works with Elizabeth at the same construction company. He is a construction worker; she is the receptionist. They have a friendly but professional relationship, mainly through his office visits for paperwork and project updates.
- Over the past few days, Keith observed Elizabeth being unusually curt/short with him.
- Keith wondered whether he had unknowingly upset her through a misunderstanding or mistake.
- Keith asked Elizabeth if he had done something to upset her, saying she seemed off with him.
- Elizabeth told him no, he had not upset her. She said she was dealing with personal stuff and apologized if she seemed short.
- Keith felt sympathetic and wanted to support her.
- Keith told Elizabeth he understood she was going through a tough time, offered to listen if she needed someone to talk to, and suggested a coffee break.
- Elizabeth accepted the coffee break and thanked him.
- During the coffee break, Elizabeth shared more about her stresses. Keith perceived them as quite severe.
- Keith told Elizabeth he appreciated her sharing and asked if she had considered talking to a professional, mentioning that an external perspective can sometimes help.
- Elizabeth said she had thought about it but was not sure; she said she was hesitant about seeking help.
- Afterward, Keith noticed Elizabeth became slightly withdrawn. He believed his suggestion might have embarrassed her and felt regretful.
- Keith told her he hoped he hadn’t overstepped and that he wanted her to know he was there to support her no matter what.
- Elizabeth told him he did not overstep, that she appreciated his concern, and that it was a lot to think about.
- Later, Keith observed Elizabeth seeming more open and appreciative. He believed she valued his support and felt more comfortable around him.
- Keith intends to maintain a supportive relationship. He told her he is always there if she needs to chat or take a break together.
- Elizabeth thanked him, said it meant a lot to her, and said she felt better knowing she had his support.
